title: PLAYER 2 SEES HIS KILLING SHOT
why: Parked by the raid text audit of 2026-10-09. In co-op the host runs every enemy, so on the second player window a round only asks the host for its damage, and the health shown there has not dropped yet when the damage number is drawn. The shot that killed always showed as a plain number, never the larger kill number. On the second window the kill is now worked out from the damage the round sends, which is exactly what the host takes off. Solo and the host are unchanged.
now: In co-op, the second player killing shot now shows the larger kill number, as the host already did.

edits.replacement:
dmgNum(en.x+fxn(-5,5),en.y-Math.round(en.r*1.1),_dn,_dc,hitKills(en,edmg));   // v8.35; v23.18: the kill style on player 2 too
                if(NET.on) netFxDmg(en.x,en.y-Math.round(en.r*1.1),_dn,_dc,hitKills(en,edmg));
